hypothesis: In the paper's eight-cell active-inference model started from identical co-located undifferentiated cells, migration toward target locations happens first and fast, differentiation into head/body/tail types follows at around the eighth time step, ensemble free energy falls as identities resolve, and identities end resolved even though each cell's identity depends on signals from other equally ambiguous cells.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered, over 20 random seeds (initial expectations with log precision -4), 32 steps: define migration time t_m as the first step at which the mean distance of cells to their best-assigned target positions falls below 50% of its value at step 0, and differentiation time t_d as the first step at which at least 6 of 8 cells have a most-probable identity of the type encoded at their assigned target and mean max identity probability exceeds 0.5. The claim is supported if, in at least 16 of 20 runs: t_m < t_d; t_d lies in [4, 16] (within a factor of 2 of the reported eighth step); ensemble free energy at step 32 is below step 1; and at step 32 mean max identity probability exceeds 0.5 with at least 7/8 cells correctly typed.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered: in fewer than 10 of 20 runs the conditions hold, or in the majority of runs differentiation precedes or coincides with migration (t_d <= t_m), or the median t_d is outside [2, 24] or never reached. Between 10 and 15 qualifying runs is 'mixed'.
planned_datasets: spm12-dem-morphogenesis (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spm/spm12/main/toolbox/DEM/DEM_morphogenesis.m; fallback to the spm12 default branch)
paper model specification: Friston, Levin, Sengupta & Pezzulo 2015, doi:10.1098/rsif.2014.1383 (claim-sources/levin-papers/inputs/2015-place.txt)

test_contract.expected_observation: Mean distance to targets halves before cells commit to identities; identities commit near step 8 (between 4 and 16); free energy falls; identities end resolved and correct in most seeded runs.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: Differentiation precedes migration, occurs far from step 8 or never, free energy does not fall, or identities stay ambiguous at step 32 in most runs.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: The generative model and parameters of the paper and its public SPM implementation. MATLAB is unavailable, so an independent Python re-implementation (gradient descent on Laplace free energy for internal states and action, not SPM's generalized filter spm_ADEM) is used; its time step is matched to the SPM loop (one time step = one update of the 32-step schedule of the extracellular-sensitivity ramp). 8-cell head-body-tail target as in the paper.
test_contract.inference_method: Per-run t_m, t_d, free-energy change and final identity resolution; count of qualifying runs against 16 (pass) and 10 (fail) out of 20; median t_d reported.
